comparison.objective: Hold a block upright while closing a vise jaw around it.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual part support and clamp closure.
comparison.success_condition: Block clamped with its top 25–45 mm above the jaws, then both hands released; further thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Vise clamping secures a workpiece and does not preserve a screw-set calibration through jam-nut countertorque.
